learn.pageTitle: Mangan and Above: Non-Dealer Tsumo Scores
learn.pageDescription: Learn the riichi mahjong scores for a non-dealer tsumo of mangan or more, and how the payment is split.
learn.bodyTitle: On a tsumo, everyone shares the payment
learn.body1:
A [[tsumo|tsumo]] has no discarder, so all the other players at the table share the payment.
The total you receive is still the same as for a [[ron|ron]], and from [[mangan|mangan]] up you still do not need to count fu.
learn.body2:
On a non-dealer tsumo, each of the other non-dealers pays the same amount, and the dealer pays twice that.
Let us look at a non-dealer winning a mangan or more by tsumo.
learn.body3:
Every total is the same as the non-dealer ron score; it is simply split among "non-dealer, non-dealer, dealer".
As long as you remember that only the dealer pays double, the totals to memorize are the same as for a non-dealer ron.
learn.halvingTitle: Halve the ron score to get the payments
learn.halvingBody1:
You do not have to memorize the numbers in the table above separately: they come straight from the non-dealer ron score.
Halve the non-dealer ron score to get what the dealer pays, and halve it again to get what each non-dealer pays.
learn.halvingBody2:
The same goes for the other limits. For [[haneman|haneman]], half of 12,000 is 6,000, and half of that is 3,000.
Read the table above in the order total, dealer, non-dealer, and every row is halved step by step.
learn.halvingNote: * Scores of mangan and above divide evenly by 4, so this never leaves a remainder. The same steps work below mangan too, but each time you halve, you have to round up to the next 100 points (<link></link>).
